purpose: Full-feature, like-for-like custom-Go measurements immediately before full-Eino adoption. Skeleton or feature-reduced binaries are not valid baselines.

measurement.commit_note: Parent of b4c5a2b (feat(app): compose AI runtime owners and wire real server transport). The tree carries the complete production composition of its line — desktop core (ab398d1), production sync boundary (7ff50bb), durable tmux recovery (89520fe) and vault payload adaptation (3e39138) — immediately before the full-Eino AI runtime adoption; the AI runtime did not exist yet, so no feature-removing build tag was used. Tower ruling 2026-10-03: these values report the full-Eino size delta only, are not a claim of strict like-for-like composition with the final release, and never waive any Rust gate.
measurement.method: Stripped release builds (Go 1.26.8, -mod=readonly -trimpath -buildvcs=false -ldflags '-s -w' -tags production, version/commit stamped, production Vite frontend embedded for desktops). linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 desktops built cgo-enabled in a golang:1.26.8-trixie container with libgtk-4-dev/libwebkitgtk-6.0-dev (amd64 via x86_64-linux-gnu-gcc multiarch cross). Archives are GNU tar --sort=name fixed-metadata tar.gz; NSIS via makensis 3.12 with the committed NexTerm.nsi and the Wails WebView2 bootstrapper; DMG via hdiutil UDZO with ad-hoc codesign. like_for_like means same artifact form as the final artifact (raw vs raw, installer vs installer), not identical feature composition.
